description.zh:
域名统计开关，取值：

- on：开启域名统计级别。
- off：用户级别数据，默认统计用户级别数据。
description.en:
The domain name statistics switch. Valid values:

- on: Enables domain name-level statistics.
- off: User-level data. User-level data is collected by default.

description.zh: 拉流结束时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内，且EndTime超过当前时间。
description.en: The end time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The time interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time.

description.zh: 专线。取值范围支持【0,9】内的整数。
description.en: The dedicated line. Valid values: integers in the range of [0, 9].

description.zh: 拉流开始时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内。
description.en: The start time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The time interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days.

title.zh: 查询用户的每日某种专线上行带宽峰值
title.en: Query daily peak upstream bandwidth of a specific dedicated line

descriptions.zh:
调用接口查询用户的每日某种专线上行带宽峰值。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
Calls the operation to query the daily peak upstream bandwidth of a specific dedicated line for a user.
## QPS limit
The QPS limit for a single user on this operation is 5 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-up-bps-peak-of-line --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2017-10-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-10-10T21:00:00Z --line 3 --domain-switch on --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
